title: Sandcastle Knight - Teddy's Guide to the Sandbox

pages.head: The Zoomies of 1995
pages.html:
Sandcastle Knight

Pittsburgh, the Fourth of July, 1995. Behind a brick house on a hill sits a wooden sandbox, and it has a knight: Teddy, a Pembroke Welsh Corgi in a tin helmet with a red plume. He is low to the ground, big in the ears, and very, very good. Teddy knows lots of tricks, he loves his toys, and everybody on the street loves him.

He also has a big sister. Gwinn is a chocolate-brown pit-lab mix with amber eyes and a pink collar, twice his size, and she ruins everything. Never on purpose! She just has a lot of zoomies.

This morning she came through the sandbox at full speed. Every castle fell flat. She stepped on the hose and it ran into the moat, tipped the kiddie pool into a lagoon, dug a hole under the whole sandbox for the beetles to move into, and scattered Teddy's toys from one end to the other. Then she flopped down on the patio for a nap, right on top of the Crown of the Sandbox.

Pick up your shovel, Teddy. Rebuild the towers, raise the gates, gather your toys, and get your crown back from under your snoring sister.

pages.head: Getting Started
pages.html:
Installing

Copy every file on this disk into one directory on your hard disk, for example C:\SANDCAST, and type SANDCAST. You need a 286 or better with VGA graphics and 640K of memory. All sound comes from the PC speaker, so no sound card is needed.

The title screen

The game dials up THE -= S A N D B O X =- BBS on its own (don't worry, your phone bill is safe) and shows the logon screen. Press any key for the menu:

  • Play starts a new game in the sandbox.
  • Read Instructions and Read Storyline show messages from the BBS message base.
  • See Highest Scores lists the Good Dogs of the Sandbox.

Leave the menu alone for half a minute and Teddy will show you around by himself. Pick Read Storyline to watch Gwinn's zoomies for yourself.

Your goal

Win back four castles, one in each corner of the sandbox, then face Gwinn. Each castle you win sets you down in the next corner, so the sandbox itself shows how far you have come.

pages.head: Controls
pages.html:
Keys

Arrows or W A S DWalk (the numeric keypad arrows work too)
GPick up the thing you are standing on
SpaceFling a clod of sand (needs the shovel)
BThrow a splash of water (needs the bucket, and water in it)
FToss a tennis ball (you need to have found one)
F1Help
F2Status: score, hit points, lives, inventory and your sand
F4Sound effects on/off
F5 / F6Save / load a game
EscQuit to the menu

Tricks

Teddy knows his tricks. Show them off any time with the number keys along the top of the keyboard:

2Sit (and offer a paw)
3Spin! Twice round, kicking up a whirl of sand that bowls over any ant or beetle that runs into it
4Play dead
5Roll over

A joystick works as well: button 1 flings sand, button 2 throws water.

Thrown sand, water and balls fly the way you last walked, so take a step toward whatever you're aiming at first.

Counting your sand

Game-Maker's status screen (F2) calls your sand Money. Every scoop of sand you carry counts as one.

pages.head: Sand, Towers and Water
pages.html:
Sand

Sand is everything in this game. Pick it up by walking over a pile of wet sand: no key needed (G is for tools like the shovel and the bucket). With the shovel, walk into a dune to dig it: two bites and it is gone, and you keep the sand.

Spend sand by walking into things:

  • Tower rings (a circle drawn in the sand, with a little flag stake): one sand builds the tower. Walk into it again to plant your flag.
  • Anthills: one sand plugs the hole for good.
  • Fords (water with wooden stakes): one sand fills a square of the moat.

Gates

A castle gate lifts when you have planted its flags: four at Anthill Keep, two at the Hosewater Moat. The gate of the lagoon wants three golden shells instead.

Water

Once you find the bucket, water balloons and Gwinn's water bowls fill it, three splashes at a time. Only water can flip a crab. And with the bucket in hand, walk into a dashed outline in the sand to pack a wall of wet sand right there. Crabs can't get past a wall.

pages.head: Things in the Sandbox
pages.html:
ItemWhat it does
Pile of wet sandOne sand
Tennis ballOne toss (F). Gwinn will move for it. So will a crab.
Squeaky boneOne of Teddy's toys: 100 points
Flying discTeddy's best toy: 500 points
Golden conchOpens the lagoon's sea gate (you need three)
Dog biscuit40 hit points back
Peanut butterAn extra life
Water balloonThree splashes for your bucket
AcornOpens one root door underground
Floppy disk300 points (shareware!)
ShovelPick it up with G. Teddy carries it in his teeth: fling sand, dig dunes.
BucketPick it up with G. Throw water, pack walls.

Things that move you

  • Hose currents carry you along. You can step out sideways, but nobody walks upstream.
  • Crumbly sand bridges fall into the water behind you. Keep walking!
  • Waves roll up the beach and push you back to shore.
  • The tidal flat floods every so often. Wait it out on a sandbar.

pages.head: Who's Who
pages.html:
CreatureNotes
AntsPour out of anthills and run at you. One bite each. A clod of sand stops them; a scoop of sand plugs the hill.
BeetlesPatrol in lines and squares. Armored, but a clod of sand flips them.
CrabsScuttle back and forth. Walk into one and it pinches hard, once, and tumbles out of the way on its back. Sand bounces off; water flips them without the pinch. Or wall them in.
Hose dropletsThe garden hose spits them across the sand. Time your crossing.
GwinnTeddy's big sister: a brown pit-lab mix, twice his size. She galumphs around the sandbox and naps in doorways, and when she's on the loose she galumphs right past you (it doesn't hurt). Asleep in a doorway, she won't budge. Sand and water don't bother her a bit. Toss her a tennis ball and she trots off happy to bury it.
Slobbery ballsRoll out of Gwinn's mouth while she snores. They roll after you. Yuck.
Rope toysFly out of Gwinn's toy box. Too tough for sand; one bonk, and it's gone.
Gwinn, nappingSix blocks of sleeping big sister on the patio. Her left paw guards the path up her side, and her right paw lies across the crown. Splash a paw twice and she tucks it in; after the first splash, the right one starts swiping. When she snores, a gust blows down the path beside her and pushes you back (it doesn't hurt). The dust stirs and a Z drifts up just before.

Remember: Gwinn is not a bad dog. She is a good girl who knocks things over. Everybody loves her too.

pages.head: Tips: The First Castles
pages.html:
The Sandbox

Grab the shovel by the toy chest first. Anthill Keep is inside the ring of dunes: dig in. Grab the tennis ball next to the shovel, too.

1. Anthill Keep

There is more sand than you need. Plug the anthills near the towers before you build, and the ants will leave you alone. Gwinn is asleep across the doorway inside: walk up toward her and press F. Out of balls? Walk into the can of tennis balls beside her; it never runs out (there is one by her nap in the lagoon, too).

2. Hosewater Moat

The hose has cut the island in two, and each half has one tower ring. Two scoops of sand fill the south ford (the west bridge is free, but it only works once). Build the south tower, then ride the east current off the island. Round on the north bank, a current runs down across the moat to the north half. Build its tower, and the channel down the west side carries you back to the gate.

pages.head: Tips: Deeper In
pages.html:
3. Low Tide Lagoon

Pick up the bucket and a tennis ball near the start; Gwinn is napping in the only gap in the toy barrier. In the crab gullies, pack a wall on one side of the crossing while the crab is away. Cross the surf between waves, and grab the golden shells on the sandbars while the tide is out. The flat darkens and foams just before it floods. If it does, stand on a sandbar and wait.

4. Beetle Burrows

Three root doors and just enough acorns, plus one hidden behind a crack. Bring sand down with you for the ford over the underground stream.

5. Gwinn's Nap

Fill up at a bowl (they never run dry), take a step toward her left paw, and throw twice. Wait at the foot of the path while a snore blows past, then walk up. In the nook, splash the right paw again before its swipe reaches you, or step back down the path.

pages.head: Secrets
pages.html:
We won't tell you everything, but:

  • Not every little hole in the sandbox was dug by an ant. One of them dials a phone number.
  • Something in the courtyard of Anthill Keep leads very deep down, and back up again.
  • Cracked walls in the burrows are worth walking into.
  • Ride the hose's lazy loop in the southeast corner. Round and round.

THE -= S A N D B O X =- BBS was a real bulletin board in Pittsburgh, PA. This game is for everyone who ever logged on. Check the file area while you're there: the SysOp just uploaded a GIF of himself and his corgi.

pages.head: Registering
pages.html:
This is Shareware

You may copy Sandcastle Knight and share it with friends, upload it to bulletin boards and put it in shareware libraries, as long as all the files stay together and unchanged.

If you enjoy it, please register for $10. Registered players get the next Teddy adventure on disk as soon as it is done, a printed map of the sandbox with every secret marked, and our thanks.
